name: Afghanistan (1980–1987)
description: A horizontal tricolour of black, red and green with the state emblem of the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan — a rising sun over a pulpit within wheat sheaves, a red star above — in the upper hoist.
history: The 1980 flag restored the black-red-green tricolour after the all-red flag of 1978–1980, keeping a socialist emblem with a red star; it was replaced in 1987 when the emblem was redesigned.

features.role: state emblem with rising sun, pulpit and red star
